transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I'm here because I've been experiencing an overwhelming amount of energy and an abnormally elevated, happy mood that I just can't seem to calm down. This has been going on constantly for about 11 months now.
During this high-energy period, have you experienced things like hearing or seeing things that others can't, or holding beliefs that others tell you aren't true?

No, I haven't seen or heard things that aren't there, and I don't hold any unusual beliefs. It's just that my mind is constantly racing with thoughts and I have so much energy that I can't seem to slow down.
Has this high-energy period caused major problems in your daily life, like severe trouble at work or in your relationships, or have you ever needed to be hospitalized because of it?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't thought much about whether it's caused major problems in my life, and I've never been hospitalized because of it.
Have you ever experienced periods in your life where you felt the exact opposite—very down, depressed, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?
No, I haven't really experienced periods like that. I don't recall ever feeling very down, depressed, or losing interest in the things I enjoy.
